patterns.note: Full-bleed hero sections with dynamic imagery or video are used extensively, often featuring a dark overlay to ensure text readability.
Content sections frequently employ a split-screen layout, dividing the viewport horizontally or vertically to showcase two distinct pieces of content side-by-side.
Headings and key labels consistently use an uppercase, bold sans-serif font, reinforcing a strong and authoritative brand voice.
The design relies on a high-contrast palette of deep blacks and whites, with the iconic Ferrari red used sparingly as a powerful accent for calls to action and branding.
Sections and content blocks reveal with a subtle fade-up animation as they scroll into the viewport, creating a dynamic and engaging browsing experience.
The primary navigation bar transitions from a transparent overlay on the hero section to a solid dark background with white text once the user scrolls down the page.

technique_notes: Full-bleed hero sections are implemented with a dark, semi-transparent overlay positioned over background images or videos to enhance text contrast and legibility.
Scroll-triggered animations are used to reveal content sections, where elements subtly fade in and slide upwards from the bottom as they enter the user's viewport, likely leveraging CSS keyframes.
The main navigation bar is designed to be sticky, dynamically changing its background from transparent to a solid dark color upon scrolling past the initial hero content.

design_tokens.type_scale: Headings are large, bold, and often uppercase sans-serifs, while body text is a clear, readable sans-serif at a standard size, with smaller uppercase labels for subheadings.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp for most structural elements and image cards, with subtle rounding on interactive elements like buttons.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced overall, featuring airy hero sections and more compact, grid-based layouts for news and article content.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its bold, high-contrast aesthetic, leveraging deep blacks and whites with strategic pops of Ferrari red to convey luxury and performance. The immersive use of full-bleed dynamic media, combined with subtle scroll-triggered reveals, creates a premium and engaging brand experience that feels both modern and iconic.
